item.title: Pakistan study suggests microbiome may influence preterm birth
item.description: A Pakistan study finds one bacteria in pregnant women's colons can indicate her likelihood of reaching full term or having a premature baby.

item.title: Platner energized Maine's Democrats. Jackson's challenge will be to keep them engaged
item.description: Democrats have a new candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine: Troy Jackson. In one of the country's most closely-watched races, he'll have less than 100 days to make his case.

item.title: Arizona, California face big cuts in anticipated new Colorado River rules
item.description: The federal government has decided how to divide the Colorado River among the seven states that share it. Climate-driven drought has made an already contentious process even more difficult.

item.title: Utah's biggest holiday recognizes the legacy of a Native massacre
item.description: Pioneer Day is Utah's 4th of July, celebrating Mormon pioneers' arrival. This year, a rare acknowledgement of a Native American massacre of which little is spoken.

item.title: Haitians face an uncertain future as TPS ends
item.description: More than 300,000 Haitians living in the United States are losing Temporary Protected Status. Many now face an uncertain legal future and possible deportation.
